parkingMode.description: The arrangement of the parking space(s) in relation to the road.

occupancyDetection.title: occupancyDetection
occupancyDetection.description: Indicates the form of detection that is used to determine space occupancy

temporarilyParking.title: temporarilyParking
temporarilyParking.description: Indicates that this campus, (sub)place or space only exists on a temporarily basis. It might close permanently within short notice or might only be partially equipped. The physical parking possibilities might be provisional, too.

distanceFromPrimaryRoad.title: distanceFromPrimaryRoad
distanceFromPrimaryRoad.description: Specifies the distance from the primary road in metres. Especially useful, if parking is located on a smaller type of road.

totalDimension.title: totalDimension
totalDimension.description: Dimension of a virtual rectangle encapsulating the area of all parking spaces in the described hierarchy level. Use 'usableArea' to define the total space available for parking within this group. Do not use 'height'.

minimumParkingSpaceDimension.title: minimumParkingSpaceDimension
minimumParkingSpaceDimension.description: Lower dimension boundaries for all spaces within the area. Note that there need not exist a space with this exact dimension, but each space's dimension values must be equal or higher.

maximumParkingSpaceDimension.title: maximumParkingSpaceDimension
maximumParkingSpaceDimension.description: Dimension of the largest space within this area (i.e. there must be at least one space of this dimension). If the comparison of dimension values is not unique, the length is decisive.

Assignment.title: Assignment
Assignment.description: An assignment for parking, optionally limited to a validity in time.

maximumParkingDuration.title: maximumParkingDuration
maximumParkingDuration.description: The maximum parking duration for this assignment (e.g. to avoid overnight parking).

minimumParkingDuration.title: minimumParkingDuration
minimumParkingDuration.description: The minimum parking duration for this assignment.

parkingAllowed.title: parkingAllowed
parkingAllowed.description: Defines, if parking is allowed or not in this assignment.

reservation.title: reservation
reservation.description: Indication of whether a parking reservation service is available and/or mandatory.

exclusivelyAssignedFor.title: exclusivelyAssignedFor
exclusivelyAssignedFor.description: Parking is only allowed for the assignment specified here, i.e. other assignments are not allowed. By using this role, it is not allowed to use 'applicableFor' and 'prohibitedFor' for the same type of attributes.

prohibitedFor.title: prohibitedFor
prohibitedFor.description: Parking is not allowed for the given assignment.

applicableFor.title: applicableFor
applicableFor.description: Assignments for parking. Other assignments are allowed as well, i.e. the parking spaces are convenient for this kind of assignment.

activationMode.description: Modes or credentials that can be used to activate a parking session or other operation (delivery, loading, etc.).

structureGrade.title: structureGrade
structureGrade.description: Defines the parking structure with respect to ground level.

robotic.title: robotic
robotic.description: Indicates existence of a robotic parking system - a parking structure where customer leaves vehicle at drop off area and robots move the vehicle to parking location in structure. Default or absence of value indicates [FALSE] = no robotic parking system.

accessControlled.title: accessControlled
accessControlled.description: Indicates facility has physical access control (e.g. barriers, gates) [TRUE] or no access control [FALSE]

staffed.title: staffed
staffed.description: Indicates facility has on-site staff [TRUE] or no on-site staff [FALSE] for the majority, but not all, of the open valid operating times.

structureType.title: structureType
structureType.description: Defines the type of parking structure.

coveredType.title: coveredType
coveredType.description: Specifies the type of covering of a place. Covered can include roof, canopy and other structures that protect the place from the environment.

openToPublic.title: openToPublic
openToPublic.description: identifies if this facility is accessible to public use [TRUE] or private use only [FALSE].

spacesNonDedicated.title: spacesNonDedicated
spacesNonDedicated.description: Number of parking spaces that are not assigned for a particular purpose.

accessForPersonsWithDisabilities.title: accessForPersonsWithDisabilities

distanceFromParkingSpace.title: distanceFromParkingSpace
distanceFromParkingSpace.description: Distance from this access to the parking space or group of parking spaces. Especially interesting for persons with disabilities or in case of the need of changing the side of a motorway.

DemandSpaceType.title: DemandSpaceType
DemandSpaceType.description: Defines when a specific space within a place is occupied, for how long, and the total amount for this space for this time. Includes when occupancy was determined.  This class includes actual and estimated start and end times of occupancy.

spaceId.title: spaceId
spaceId.description: Name of space, specifically identifies each individual space in an area.

actualStart.title: actualStart
actualStart.description: The actual time a space is initially occupied.

actualEnd.title: actualEnd
actualEnd.description: The actual Time space is vacated.

detectionUpdateTime.title: detectionUpdateTime
detectionUpdateTime.description: Time of update, from detector which is typically a space sensor or camera.

estimatedStart.title: estimatedStart

estimatedEnd.title: estimatedEnd
estimatedEnd.description: The estimated time a space is expected to be vacated, typically based on a reservation.

frequency.title: frequency

timestamp.title: timestamp
timestamp.description: Timestamp when the demand table data was compiled.

creationTime.title: creationTime
creationTime.description: When data in the record was compiled.

occupancyCalculation.description: Is occupancy based on physical count, derived (calculated), or a verified report (high confidence report)

numberOfOccupiedSpaces.description: The number of currently occupied spaces in the specified parking site, group of parking sites or assigned parking.

numberOfVehicles.title: numberOfVehicles
numberOfVehicles.description: Number of vehicles (of specified type) on the specified area. Parking too narrow or too wide may affect differences to the 'occupiedSpaces' value. Should not include petrol station traffic.

occupancy.title: occupancy
occupancy.description: The percentage value of parking spaces occupied in the specified parking site, group of parking sites or assigned parking.

occupancyGraded.title: occupancyGraded
occupancyGraded.description: Occupied parking spaces by a percentage-grading (enumeration).

occupancyTrend.title: occupancyTrend
occupancyTrend.description: The trend of the occupancy of the parking spaces in the specified parking site, group of parking sites or assigned parking.

parkingNotAllowed.title: parkingNotAllowed
parkingNotAllowed.description: In case of 'true', parking is not allowed (e.g. abnormal closure).

probability.title: probability
probability.description: The probability that at least one parking space within the specified parking element is available.

overrideThresholdConfiguration.title: overrideThresholdConfiguration
overrideThresholdConfiguration.description: Possibility to override the thresholds for the parking, which are in principle defined in the static part of the model (ParkingStatusPublication).

numberOfIncomingVehicles.title: numberOfIncomingVehicles
numberOfIncomingVehicles.description: Number of vehicles of specified type that entered the specified parking within the given interval.

numberOfOutgoingVehicles.title: numberOfOutgoingVehicles
numberOfOutgoingVehicles.description: Number of vehicles of specified type that left the specified parking within the given interval.

changeOfOccupiedSpaces.title: changeOfOccupiedSpaces
changeOfOccupiedSpaces.description: The change in the number of occupied spaces for specified vehicles within the given interval. Negative values mean less occupied spaces than at the beginning of the interval.

VehicleRate.title: VehicleRate
VehicleRate.description: Information about vehicle fill and exit rates or the general vehicle flow rate without direction.

fillRate.title: fillRate
fillRate.description: The rate at which vehicles are entering the parking expressed in vehicles per hour.

exitRate.title: exitRate
exitRate.description: The rate at which vehicles are exiting the parking expressed in vehicles per hour.

vehicleFlowRate.title: vehicleFlowRate
vehicleFlowRate.description: A value of vehicle flow rate expressed in vehicles per hour.

VehiclesOnSiteThresholds.description: The threshold is defined by the number of vehicles on the parking. This may differ from the number of occupied spaces, for example when vehicles share spaces.

lowerThreshold.title: lowerThreshold
lowerThreshold.description: A lower threshold from which the specified parking site status should become active.

upperThreshold.title: upperThreshold
upperThreshold.description: An upper threshold up to which the specified parking site status should become active.
